tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background, edge to edge. Near-black with a cold bias so the cut to and from the NBT picture and the CarPlay stream lands on black.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Reserved for a band that must stand off `ground`. The only fill that may touch the screen edge besides `ground`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Resting fill of tiles and cards (the drawn glass). Sits on `ground` only.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Touch-pressed fill, quiet pills, and tiles nested inside a `surface` card.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between list rows. Decorative only: never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (unselected radio, disabled-control edge, empty slot). 3:1 on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `ground`, `ground-raised`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `amber-wash`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row values, captions, the date. On `ground`, `ground-raised`, `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and inactive status marks on `ground`, `ground-raised` and `surface`. Not on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The iDrive controller focus ring, and nothing else. One amber element per screen. BMW's orange-red, the colour of the instrument lighting and the NBT menu highlight; sampled from a photo of the NBT main menu and lifted for contrast. Refine against the car's own screen.

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind the focused list row, inside the amber ring. Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: amber-press
tokens.usage: Fill of the focused row during the acknowledge flash and while an amount is being adjusted. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on a solid `amber` fill (the knob-position pip, a focused scrubber thumb).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Phone-side action: the control that opens or returns to CarPlay, and the active-session tile.

tokens.name: blue-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected-but-not-focused phone or option.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Label on a `blue` fill. Meets 3:1 only, so use it at `label-20` (semibold) or larger, never for body text.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Link is up: CarPlay connected, Wi-Fi joined. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: In progress or degraded: connecting, weak signal, running from USB. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Full mode only: tile and card fill over the baked wallpaper, in place of `surface`. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`; never `ink-faint`.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Full mode only: pressed fill and quiet pills over the wallpaper, in place of `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Failed or blocked: no phone found, pairing refused. A pink-leaning red, kept well away from `amber` so a fault is never mistaken for focus. Only as the small square in a status chip, beside a word; never a ring, border or fill.

families.sans: Inter, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: clock-96
styles.usage: The idle clock only. Digits and colon, tabular. Light weight is the nod to NBT's thin Helvetica. LVGL: subset to 0-9 and ':'.

styles.name: display-48
styles.usage: One per screen: the thing the screen is about (the phone's name, a connect state).

styles.name: title-36
styles.usage: Screen title in the header band, top-left, as NBT places it.

styles.name: name-28
styles.usage: A phone's name on its tile. Two lines at most. Shares its font with the clock in the top band.

styles.name: row-32
styles.usage: List row labels and values. Fills just over half of the 60px row, the dense proportion of an NBT menu. Weight never changes with focus, so rows do not reflow.

styles.name: body-24
styles.sample: Hold the voice button to pair a new phone.
styles.usage: Explanatory text in cards and dialogs. Three lines at most.

styles.name: label-20
styles.usage: Pill buttons, status pills, tile captions. The smallest size in the system.

styles.name: eyebrow-20
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a display line. Shares the `label-20` bitmap font; only tracking and case differ.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-dot nudges; ring offset on tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its word; between stacked text lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles; icon to label inside a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row and pill inner padding, left and right.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between unrelated groups inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Car-side shapes: list rows and their focus ring. Close to NBT's square highlight.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Phone-side shapes: tiles and cards. A focus ring around one is 28px (radius plus the 4px offset) so the corners stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status chips: at least half the height of anything up to one band.

tokens.name: edge-light
tokens.usage: The 1px top highlight that makes a `surface` tile read as glass without any blur. Both modes. In LVGL: a 1px top border in white at this opacity.

tokens.name: focus-glow
tokens.usage: Full mode only: soft amber halo outside the focus ring, NBT's glowing highlight. Pre-render it as a nine-patch image; do not compute it per frame. Lite draws the ring alone.

tokens.name: screen-w
tokens.usage: Panel width.

tokens.name: screen-h
tokens.usage: Panel height: eight bands.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The vertical module, NBT's row pitch: eight to the screen. Header band, every list row and every touch target is one band tall (about 11 mm on the 10.25 inch panel).

tokens.name: pill-h
tokens.usage: Visible height of a pill button; its touch area is the full band.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Row and tile icons. The marks in the top band are 28px.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Width of the amber focus ring.

tokens.name: dur-ack
tokens.usage: Acknowledge: the pressed fill fade and the ring-fill flash on a push. Full mode; Lite switches in one frame.

tokens.name: dur-step
tokens.usage: Ring travel for one knob detent, ease-out. Shortens to 60ms when detents arrive faster than this.

tokens.name: dur-bump
tokens.usage: The 6px nudge-and-return at the end of a list.

tokens.name: dur-scroll
tokens.usage: List rows sliding one band.

tokens.name: dur-screen
tokens.usage: Screen change: 100ms out, 100ms in.
